text.tspan: 1. Producer should produce the message in a particular topic/queue.
2. Consumer should be able to read the message from the queue.
3. Message should not be read by multiple consumers at a same time unless its Pub-Sub queue with multiple subscribers.
2. Writes should be <100ms, reads should be <500ms
Standard SQS doesn't follow any order for messages
Kafka or FIFO SQS maintains queue for every key, sequence order is followed for same key
DB can be sharded based on queue
